summary: Ret sub-Holy with Exorcism, for an Undead or Demon boss.
advantage: Exorcism only works on Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
advantageShort: Exorcism only hits Undead and Demons. Purifying Power 2 makes its cooldown a third shorter.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Righteousness whenever no damage seal is up

Unsealed Wrath: with Seal of Righteousness up, once it has stored all 3 copies, Seal of Command, so the next swing spends them all (one Righteousness hit each) and stores a Command copy. Back to Seal of Righteousness once Command has stored all 3, keeping the mana for Exorcism
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Unsealed Wrath is new with the October 30 hotfix and unverified: the sim lets landed white swings store and spend the copies, and rolls each stored Seal of Command at its own 7 a minute.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization raises all Holy damage as well as physical, and Vengeance stacks up to 5 times, as the November 2 development notes announce. Client 1.60.1.70753 still has Physical only and 3 stacks; the sim takes the notes' values until a hotfix or client build says otherwise (standards 37).
No Holy Wrath. Its 2s cast resets the swing.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as paladin__level_60_sub_holy except talents and APL, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeUndead, as the class preset's encounter does. Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human (follows its base build, paladin__level_60_sub_holy). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh).
